set: GK Drill 1: States, places and India-firsts

sections.name: GK drill: States, places and India-firsts

questions.q: Which state became the first inland state in India to export value-added Tilapia fish (2026)?
questions.why: Asked in the September 2026 GPSC papers.

questions.q: India's first Telecom Manufacturing Zone is to be set up in which city?
questions.why: Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh (2026).

questions.q: Which state was declared India's first paperless judiciary state in 2026?
questions.why: Asked in the May 2026 GPSC papers.

questions.q: India's first and only pearl-farming cluster has been set up in:
questions.why: Notified in May 2026.

questions.q: India's first Dark Sky Park in Tamil Nadu (2026) is located in:
questions.why: Declared in March 2026. Hanle in Ladakh is India's first dark-sky reserve.

questions.q: 'Mission Golden Spice' was launched in 2026 to promote which GI-tagged product of Meghalaya?
questions.why: Lakadong turmeric is known for its high curcumin content.

questions.q: Which state made snakebite a notifiable disease in August 2026?
questions.why: Notifiable means every case must be reported to the health authorities.

questions.q: Which state became the first in independent India to implement a Uniform Civil Code (January 2025)?
questions.why: Goa already had the Portuguese-era civil code before liberation, so Uttarakhand was first after independence.

questions.q: India's first river kinetic energy project, developed with Norway, is in:
questions.why: It uses the flow of a river without a dam.

questions.q: The 'Mee Bhoomi–Blockchain' land-record pilot was launched by:
questions.why: Andhra Pradesh featured in the most 'first' questions in 2026.

questions.q: India's first integrated underground coal gasification project is planned in which state?
questions.why: Announced with Reliance in 2026.

questions.q: Google's ₹1.35 lakh crore AI hub is being built at:
questions.why: Andhra Pradesh, announced in 2025–26.

questions.q: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport, opened in 2026, is at:
questions.why: In Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh.

questions.q: Which city's 'Prakriti Gyan Dham' is described as a first-of-its-kind eco-educational hub?
questions.why: Uttar Pradesh, 2026.

questions.q: India's first riverine lighthouses were installed along which National Waterway?
questions.why: National Waterway 2 is the Brahmaputra from Dhubri to Sadiya.

questions.q: Which airport was declared an international airport in March 2026?
questions.why: Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: In August 2026 the Lok Sabha passed a bill to rename which state?
questions.why: Renaming a state needs a Parliament law under Article 3.

questions.q: India's first vertical-lift sea bridge, opened in April 2025, is the new:
questions.why: It links Rameswaram island to the mainland, Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: The Shekhawati havelis, added to UNESCO's tentative list in 2026, are in:
questions.why: Famous for painted mansions in Jhunjhunu, Sikar and Churu.

questions.q: The world's highest railway arch bridge, opened in June 2025, is over the river:
questions.why: In Reasi district, Jammu and Kashmir.

questions.q: Bengaluru's Namma 112 became India's first emergency helpline to use:
The AI-based robot 'G-SPIDER' for cleaning hazardous canals was deployed in:
questions.why: Kerala, March 2026.

questions.q: Arunachal Pradesh hosted which continental championship in 2026?
questions.why: Held on the Siang river.

questions.q: The first Khelo India Tribal Games were hosted by:
India's first state bird atlas was prepared by Kerala. Which state published the second, in February 2026?
questions.why: The Goa Bird Atlas mapped birds across the state's grid.
